name: What is the process for installing a custom kitchen island?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a custom kitchen island?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing a custom kitchen island typically begins with a detailed design consultation to finalize materials, dimensions, and features. Following design approval, custom cabinetry is fabricated off-site. Installation involves preparing the site, securing the base, installing utilities (if applicable), countertop placement, and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we provide regular updates and maintain open communication, ensuring the final product meets your vision and our high standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom kitchen island installation involves design consultation, off-site fabrication, site preparation, base and utility installation, countertop placement, and finishing. We provide updates throughout the process.
